sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.spec.ts:1-19: stk constructs a native Contract with conId/symbol/STK/USD; pushUpdate passes Decimal quantity plus string market/account values to updatePortfolio.
entries.currentBehavior: 测试夹具直接创建 SDK Contract，并把数量作为 Decimal、价格与账户字段作为字符串传给 RequestBridge.updatePortfolio；它把 native SDK 对象和可变回调入口当作测试边界。
entries.problem: 夹具验证 callback wiring，却没有验证外部输入解码、AccountScope、InstrumentId 或单位；直接复用会让 SDK Contract 和 Decimal 穿透领域，并掩盖账户/币种缺失。
preservedBehavior: 保留 Decimal 输入和 string wire 字段覆盖，因为 IBKR 实际同时使用二者。
有意不再把 SDK Contract 当领域对象，遵守 native object 不越 adapter。
openQuestions: IBKR managed account callback 是否始终提供 accountName 未由本地源证明；缺失时必须由连接选定 AccountScope 注入并保留 provenance。

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.spec.ts:21-58: local TCP server replies with greeting then nextValidId=700; waitForConnect resolves, EClient isConnected() is true, getNextOrderId() returns 700, finally disconnects.
entries.currentBehavior: 测试服务器按 greeting/start-api 两阶段回复，nextValidId=700 后 waitForConnect 成功；测试观察 connected 与 order counter，并在 finally disconnect。
entries.problem: 成功条件只看 nextValidId/socket，未证明 managed account、account subscription 或 capability reach；native order counter 也不能作为 durable dispatch identity。
preservedBehavior: 保留 serverVersion→nextValidId 顺序和 finalizer disconnect。
将“nextValidId 即 ready”改为“协议就绪 + 账户可达”。
openQuestions: 测试 payload 的 SDK 版本兼容性需在实现 slice 锁定；当前不声称已验证。

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.spec.ts:60-91: server destroys socket after first data; waitForConnect rejects handshake-specific text before 1s and listener readiness is observed.
entries.currentBehavior: 服务器收到首个客户端数据后 destroy socket；测试确认 close listener 已安装、waitForConnect 快速 reject，并清理 spy/server。
entries.problem: 只断言 message text 和本地 Promise reject；未建模 attempt identity、socket release exactly-once，半连接可能污染下一代连接。
preservedBehavior: 保留 prompt rejection 与 listener-before-send 竞态防护。
把文本匹配升级为 typed phase/cause。
openQuestions: SDK 在 close 后是否仍会异步发 nextValidId 未由 wrapper 证明，必须以 attempt token 丢弃。

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.spec.ts:93-121: silent TCP server consumes greeting and never responds; a 50ms waitForConnect timeout rejects under 500ms and client.isConnected() is false.
entries.currentBehavior: 静默服务器接受连接但不完成协议；50ms timeout reject，耗时小于500ms 且 client.isConnected() 为 false。
entries.problem: generic NETWORK timeout 与 Promise.race 可能遗留独立 timer/连接；isConnected=false 不能证明 Scope 无泄漏。
preservedBehavior: 保留 silent peer 快速 timeout 和 isConnected=false。
使用 deterministic Clock/Scope evidence 替代仅 wall-clock 阈值。
openQuestions: EClient 额外协议 timer 生命周期未由当前测试证明；实现需覆盖 socket close 证据。

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.spec.ts:124-133: requestSnapshot(9001) is pending, error callback code 10089 with subscription text rejects that request instead of timing out.
entries.currentBehavior: 测试先注册 reqId=9001 snapshot，再传入 10089；pending promise 立即以包含 subscription 的错误 reject，回归注释说明旧的 >=2000 规则误吞 10xxx。
entries.problem: 如果把所有高编号 error 当 informational，会把 entitlement/capability failure 变成无上下文 timeout；当前仍以 Error.message 传递行为。
preservedBehavior: 保留 10089 request-specific prompt failure。
不把 10089 当 network timeout，也不声称 request 是 mutation。

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.spec.ts:135-139: error(-1,...,2104,...) with no pending request does not throw.
entries.currentBehavior: 21xx farm-status callback 在无 pending request 时被忽略，测试只要求不抛异常。
entries.problem: 静默忽略会丢失健康/数据源变化信息；把 farm status 当请求失败又会错误 reject unrelated reads。
preservedBehavior: 保留 2104 no-throw 和 no pending-reject。
增加 structured health evidence，避免 old ignore 丢诊断。
openQuestions: Exact meaning of every 21xx code not locally enumerated; unknown members remain informational.

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.spec.ts:141-157: 1100 sets connectionDead and emits dead; 1102 emits restored while dead remains true; markAlive clears dead and emits alive.
entries.currentBehavior: 测试验证 1100 立即 dead、1102 只发 restored 不清 dead，markAlive 才恢复 alive；listener 接收 untyped {state,error?}。
entries.problem: 1101/1102 restored hint 与 confirmed readiness 混淆会让 stale account cache 被当作 healthy；boolean dead 丢失 connection/account/attempt evidence。
preservedBehavior: 保留 dead/restored/alive distinction and explicit 1102 not-proof-of-life。
markAlive 只由 readiness owner 发出，不再是任意 setter。
openQuestions: 1101 “data maintained” does not prove private account subscriptions; design requires reach check.

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.spec.ts:160-175: two requestCurrentTime calls produce one reqCurrentTime wire call; currentTime callback resolves both with same timestamp.
entries.currentBehavior: 两个并发 requestCurrentTime 共享 currentTimePromise，只调用一次 client.reqCurrentTime；currentTime callback 将同一秒值送给两个 Promise。
entries.problem: coalescing 正确，但 mutable singleton 未绑定 Scope/connection generation；旧连接 callback 可能完成新 probe，失败类型和 cancellation 不可见。
preservedBehavior: 保留 one-wire/many-callers and same timestamp。
新增 generation/cancellation，防止 reconnect contamination。
openQuestions: Native currentTime unit/clock skew contract must be recorded; source only treats it as seconds.

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.spec.ts:177-190: first reqCurrentTime send throws synchronously, Promise rejects; next call sends again and resolves from currentTime callback.
entries.currentBehavior: 第一次 reqCurrentTime 同步 throw，第一次 Promise reject；清理后第二次请求可重新 wire send 并由 callback 成功 resolve，调用计数为2。
entries.problem: 若 synchronous send failure 不清 in-flight state，后续 heartbeat 永久复用失败 Promise；generic BrokerError 无法说明是否安全重试。
preservedBehavior: 保留 failed probe 可 retry and no stale promise。
明确 probe failure 与 order DispatchStarted 后的 Unknown 不同，但不宣称 send throw 发生在远端边界之前。
openQuestions: SDK may throw after bytes written is unknown; if unprovable classify probe ambiguity, never mutation authority.

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.spec.ts:192-200: requestSnapshot(...resolveOnBidAsk:true) resolves immediately after positive BID=2 and ASK=4 ticks.
entries.currentBehavior: resolveOnBidAsk snapshot 收到正 bid/ask 后立即复制 accumulator resolve，未等待 tickSnapshotEnd。
entries.problem: 只以 number>0 判断可用，不记录 live/delayed quality、currency、timestamp 或 symbol identity；早完成后晚到 ticks 无 projection provenance。
preservedBehavior: 保留 positive bid/ask early completion optimization。
quality/currency/timestamp become explicit instead of raw numeric object。

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.spec.ts:202-217: ordinary snapshot remains unresolved after BID/ASK until tickSnapshotEnd, then resolves with both values.
entries.currentBehavior: 普通 snapshot 即使 BID/ASK 已到也保持 pending；tickSnapshotEnd 才 resolve accumulated bid/ask。
entries.problem: completion boundary 只由 callback Map 控制，未定义 end marker 缺失/partial quality；timeout cleanup 会丢证据并把 no ticks 与 delayed data 混成 network error。
preservedBehavior: 保留 ordinary snapshot waits for end。
missing fields become explicit completeness/failure instead of implicit undefined/zero downstream。
openQuestions: IBKR may emit end without all fields; required-field policy must be explicit caller input.

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.spec.ts:220-237: comments define full accountDownloadEnd bursts vs deltas; readyBridge seeds pending positions/values, sends rows, then accountDownloadEnd.
entries.currentBehavior: fixture 通过私有 accountCachePending_ 注入空 pending，推 AAPL/TSLA 与 TotalCashValue，再 accountDownloadEnd 形成 ready cache；注释说明 full burst 以 end 结束、delta 无 end。
entries.problem: 依赖 private-field cast 和 mutable cache，不能证明重连、AccountScope、sequence/checkpoint 或 crash recovery；bridge buffer 被误作 accounting authority。
preservedBehavior: 保留 full-vs-delta and initial readiness at end。
删除 private cache manipulation，改为 durable projection semantics。
openQuestions: IBKR ordering between downloadEnd/deltas across reconnect unavailable; gaps force rebaseline.

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.spec.ts:239-247: after readyBridge, a second AAPL portfolio row qty=9 updates live cache immediately and TSLA remains.
services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.ts:604-642: updatePortfolio receives no native stream sequence; any ordering value must be assigned by the adapter.
entries.currentBehavior: baseline 完成后发送 AAPL delta=9；getAccountCache 立即显示 AAPL=9 且仍有两行。
entries.problem: assertion 只观察 mutable array/native conId；没有 observedAt/AccountScope，也未证明 delta 在 durable projection 前可读。
preservedBehavior: 保留 delta 即时可见和 other position retention。
visibility 绑定 projection sequence/freshness，不是 mutable cache pointer。

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.spec.ts:249-255: TSLA zero-quantity update removes conId=2 immediately; cache positions equals [1].
entries.currentBehavior: 零数量 updatePortfolio row 会从 live positions 删除 TSLA，AAPL 保留；不等下一次 downloadEnd。
entries.problem: zero 语义只藏在 mutable array helper；若把零数量当普通 row 或等待 full snapshot，closed exposure 会持续暴露并影响 close/guard。
preservedBehavior: 保留 zero update immediate removal。
显式建模 ClosedPosition evidence，不再从 array 静默删除。
openQuestions: Zero may represent no position vs transient row; design treats scoped callback as conclusive only with source-quality evidence.

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.spec.ts:257-261: updateAccountValue TotalCashValue USD=900 after readyBridge immediately replaces live cache value without downloadEnd.
entries.currentBehavior: account value delta 900/USD 在下一次 downloadEnd 前即可读到 live cache。
entries.problem: Map<string,string> 无 Money unit、currency provenance、scope、timestamp，也不区分 BASE authority；reader 可把 USD 当 base。
preservedBehavior: 保留 immediate delta visibility。
raw string Map 改成 unit-qualified Money 与 explicit base selection。
openQuestions: IBKR tag families not exhaustive; codec versions families and preserves unknown qualified rows.

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.spec.ts:263-274: repeated AAPL updates and TSLA update before end yield exactly two rows; latest AAPL quantity=9.
entries.currentBehavior: 同一 conId AAPL 重复三次只留下一个最新 row；TSLA 保留，最终 length=2。
entries.problem: findIndex/upsert 做 local dedup，但 conId native/global；durable replay/idempotency sequence absent，reconnect duplicates or accounts may collide。
preservedBehavior: 保留 repeated updates coalesce/latest and preserve other rows。
key scope broadened from conId to AccountScope+InstrumentId and fold replayable。
openQuestions: conId uniqueness across linked accounts unproven; always bind AccountScope and validate metadata.

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.spec.ts:276-284: TSLA zero delta removes it; following full burst containing only AAPL then accountDownloadEnd leaves only AAPL.
services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.ts:604-678: updatePortfolio and accountDownloadEnd callbacks expose no broker sequence or full-download cursor.
entries.currentBehavior: mid-window closure 后 full-download swap 仍只剩 AAPL；TSLA 未被 pending/live merge 复活。
entries.problem: 依赖把 zero removal 同时施加到两个 mutable buffer；crash/reconnect/out-of-order full row 可丢 closure marker 并 resurrect stale exposure。
preservedBehavior: 保留 non-resurrection invariant。
array mutation 改为 explicit tombstone/generation algorithm，确保重启一致性。

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.spec.ts:286-293: readyBridge privately seeds accountCachePending_ with empty positions/values, calls accountDownloadEnd, then returns the cache-backed bridge.
entries.currentBehavior: currency tests use readyBridge to bypass subscription and create an empty completed cache by mutating private pending state.
entries.problem: private cast makes fixture coupled to implementation and cannot express selected AccountScope/base currency; it also bypasses readiness invariants.
preservedBehavior: 保留 currency tests 从 empty cache 开始的意图。
通过 public typed observation constructor 替代 private field mutation。

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.spec.ts:294-302: CashBalance BASE=1036370 then HKD=-51005 leaves plain CashBalance as BASE and stores both CashBalance:HKD and :BASE.
entries.currentBehavior: BASE line sets plain/composite values; later HKD sets only composite and cannot clobber plain BASE。
entries.problem: plain string key encodes precedence implicitly; it does not distinguish consolidated Money from provisional currency data or preserve scope.
preservedBehavior: 保留 BASE precedence and all composite rows。
plain key 改为 derived display field with explicit provenance, not raw authority。
openQuestions: Tag family semantics incomplete; only explicit BASE authoritative, absent BASE remains provisional.

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.spec.ts:304-311: HKD CashBalance arrives first and populates plain key provisionally; late BASE replaces plain key while preserving HKD composite.
entries.currentBehavior: late BASE corrects provisional plain value; HKD composite survives。
entries.problem: last-write-wins leaves plain key ambiguous; correction needs state distinguishing provisional vs authoritative BASE or readers cache wrong value.
preservedBehavior: 保留 late BASE correction and HKD retention。
arrival order independence 由 ADT/reducer 显式表达。
openQuestions: BASE may be absent indefinitely; callers handle Provisional rather than silently convert.

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.spec.ts:313-319: single NetLiquidation USD row retains plain key; ExchangeRate:USD remains absent.
entries.currentBehavior: 仅一条 USD NetLiquidation 没有 BASE；plain NetLiquidation 保留，但不创建 ExchangeRate:USD。
entries.problem: 把任意 currency 行推成 FX rate 会误解释 account metric；plain fallback 也需标 provisional，不能当 consolidated。
preservedBehavior: 保留 plain key compatibility and absence of ExchangeRate:USD。
显式标 provisional，使 target readers 不把它当 consolidated。

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.ts:1-37: RequestBridge extends DefaultEWrapper, imports raw Contract/Order callback types, BrokerError/buildPosition, and adapter-local Promise payload types; one class routes all SDK callbacks.
entries.currentBehavior: 模块把 socket callbacks、account projection、error classification、request registries、order cache 与 Promise API 集中在 legacy domain/trading/brokers/ibkr seam。
entries.problem: 单一 class 同时拥有 connection lifetime、account state 和 mutation waiter，导致 raw SDK objects、legacy BrokerError、unknown collectors 穿透 SPI；任何 callback 分拆都可能改变 correlation。
preservedBehavior: 保留 IBKR-specific callback handling and reqId multiplexing at edge。
删除 bridge as public Promise facade and move buildPosition to account mapper.

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.ts:39-41: DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS=10000, SNAPSHOT_TIMEOUT_MS=12500, ACCOUNT_READY_TIMEOUT_MS=20000 are fixed constants.
entries.currentBehavior: 三个操作固定 deadline 被 setTimeout 使用，所有 request failures 大多归为 NETWORK。
entries.problem: 固定毫秒值没有 operation policy、connection generation、retry/backpressure 或 mutation ambiguity；同一 timeout 不能同时表示 read 未完成和 write 已跨 remote boundary。
preservedBehavior: 保留 distinct default/snapshot/account timeout intent。
改变 all-timeout-as-NETWORK to state-aware typed outcomes。

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.ts:43-49: mutable numeric nextReqId/nextOrderId, one accountId string, and mutable EClient reference are stored on bridge.
entries.currentBehavior: bridge 从 10000 分配 reqId，保存 nextValidId order counter、一个 accountId_ 和 EClient 引用；所有状态和 client 生命周期依赖对象可变字段。
entries.problem: numeric ids alias request/order/dispatch concepts; first/one account loses linked account identity; client is not Scope-owned. Reconnect can reuse state without generation fence.
preservedBehavior: Keep reqId starting range only as adapter implementation detail if collision evidence supports it。
Remove first-account implicit selection and setter-owned client lifecycle.
openQuestions: IBKR native reqId/orderId uniqueness across reconnect/clientId is unverified; adapter must retain lookup evidence and conservative collision handling.

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.ts:50-60: pending is Map<number,PendingRequest> with unknown default, collectors Map<number,unknown[]>, orderPending keyed by native orderId.
entries.currentBehavior: registry 用 reqId/orderId 分离 Map，但 PendingRequest generic unknown、collector unknown[]、orderPending 仅按 native orderId；类型关联在 resolve 时消失。
entries.problem: callback family 不与 action/ack/observation/failure 关联；same native ID can collide across generations; malformed payload can resolve a wrong waiter.
preservedBehavior: 保留 reqId multiplexing and orderId callback routing。
remove unknown[]/unknown result casts and separate dispatch identity from native order id.
openQuestions: Whether one native reqId can be reused before late callback is unknown; avoid reuse within generation horizon until evidence.

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.ts:61-90: open/completed orders use single-slot collectors; account cache buffers are mutable; fillData_ is in-memory Map keyed by native orderId.
entries.currentBehavior: 批量 collector each only one slot，concurrent call can overwrite prior resolver；account data lives in pending/live arrays/maps；fills stored only by orderId for later sync。
entries.problem: single-slot loses concurrent listing evidence; caches lack scope/sequence/checkpoint; fill data disappears on restart and cannot prove dispatch outcome.
preservedBehavior: 保留 ability to query open/completed orders and enrich fills。
remove singleton collectors and ephemeral fill authority; unsupported namespace cannot return [] as complete.
openQuestions: IBKR listing completeness and callback namespace coverage/idempotency are unproven; expose Partial/Unavailable until empirical evidence.

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.ts:91-100: handshake/probe resolve/reject/timer fields and untyped connectionStateListener are mutable bridge state.
entries.currentBehavior: 连接握手和 current-time probe 都由 Promise callbacks/timers 字段控制；listener 只能接收 BrokerConnectionStateEvent 的松散 callback。
entries.problem: lifecycle not Scope-owned, no connection/generation/account reach evidence, and detached timers can outlive attempt; listener cannot express dead/restored/readiness distinction.
preservedBehavior: 保留 handshake/probe one-at-a-time semantics and listener emission intent。
replace mutable promises/timers with scoped Effect/Stream.

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.ts:104-111: setClient accepts mutable EClient; setConnectionStateListener accepts optional untyped callback and stores both.
entries.currentBehavior: 调用方可在运行中替换 client/listener；bridge 对 client lifetime 与 listener deregistration 没有 ownership enforcement。
entries.problem: setter enables client replacement during pending callbacks and listener leaks across reconnect; API cannot enforce Scope/finalizer or typed health stream.
preservedBehavior: 保留 ability for application to subscribe to health。
删除 ambient setClient/setConnectionStateListener mutability and move construction to Layer.

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.ts:113-125: allocReqId starts at 10000; getNextOrderId increments nextOrderId_; getAccountId returns accountId_ from managedAccounts.
entries.currentBehavior: reqId 从10000递增；orderId 由 nextValidId 后递增；getAccountId 只返回 managedAccounts 第一个账户。
entries.problem: first-account policy loses linked account identity and conflates native order id with client/broker/dispatch ids; automatic discovery can pick wrong account and no subaccount scope enters observations.
preservedBehavior: 保留 numeric allocation for SDK requests/orders。
有意删除 accounts[0] default and keep AccountDirectory separate from selected AccountScope。
openQuestions: IBKR account string format and subaccount semantics not proven; preserve opaque AccountId and require explicit directory evidence.

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.ts:130-183: waitForConnect stores client, supersedes old connect, starts timeout, catches handshake rejection to disconnect, Promise.allSettled(connect,handshake), and disconnects on failure.
entries.currentBehavior: waitForConnect 同时观察 transport connect 和 nextValidId handshake；旧 attempt 被 reject，失败/timeout disconnect，成功仅在 nextValidId handshake resolve。
entries.problem: Promise orchestration is outside Effect Scope; success is pre-account readiness; replacing attempts can generate late callbacks; raw failure loses phase and attempt evidence.
preservedBehavior: 保留 observe-both-promises and best-effort disconnect safety。
改变 nextValidId-only readiness and generic Error to typed staged readiness。
openQuestions: Whether EClient.connect rejection means bytes were sent is native unknown; treat post-connect mutation state separately and never infer transaction retry.

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.ts:185-196: clearConnectWaiter clears timer/resolve/reject; rejectConnect clears then rejects active connect.
entries.currentBehavior: waiter cleanup clears timer and callbacks before rejecting active connect attempt; it only manages local Promise fields.
entries.problem: cleanup is not a typed lifecycle transition, may race late callback, and has no connection generation or durable recovery checkpoint.
preservedBehavior: 保留 clear timer before reject and best-effort cleanup。
make lifecycle explicit and exactly-once; no promise callback leakage.
openQuestions: Exact SDK callback ordering after disconnect remains empirical; token fence is mandatory.

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.ts:200-218: request<T> registers generic pending and timer; timeout removes maps and rejects BrokerError NETWORK; requestCollector stores unknown[] then invokes request.
entries.currentBehavior: generic request uses unknown PendingRequest and timer; collector stores unknown[] in same registry; every timeout removes local state and emits NETWORK.
entries.problem: read vs mutation timeout indistinguishable; no request schema/correlation generation; local deletion erases evidence and no durable Observe job.
preservedBehavior: 保留 request and collector registration concept for read families。
remove generic unknown registry and generic NETWORK timeout, especially for mutations.

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.ts:220-229: requestSnapshot allocates empty TickSnapshot, optional resolveOnBidAsk set, then reuses generic request timeout cleanup.
entries.currentBehavior: snapshot accumulator is optional numeric bag; resolve-on-bid/ask behavior is flag and result is generic Promise TickSnapshot.
entries.problem: no InstrumentId/currency/quality/timestamp/partial state; generic cleanup cannot distinguish no-data timeout from entitlement failure or late tick.
preservedBehavior: 保留 resolveOnBidAsk optimization flag semantics。
replace optional numeric bag and generic Promise with typed QuoteObservation/completeness.

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.ts:233-275: requestOrder waits for openOrder; requestOpenOrders/requestCompletedOrders use singleton collectors; getFillData exposes ephemeral fills.
entries.currentBehavior: requestOrder registers one orderPending waiter keyed by native orderId and resolves it from openOrder; requestOpenOrders and requestCompletedOrders each overwrite a single collector, issue reqOpenOrders/reqCompletedOrders(true), and resolve arrays only at their end callback; timeout rejects a generic NETWORK error. getFillData exposes only positive filled/avgFillPrice values from an in-memory native-orderId Map.
entries.problem: openOrder callback is treated as write acknowledgement although it is observation; singleton batches collide; no DispatchPlanned barrier, native identity lookup, unknown outcome, or listing completeness.
preservedBehavior: 保留 order APIs and fill visibility through typed projections。
删除 openOrder-as-ack, local cancel synthetic success, singleton collectors, and ephemeral fill authority。
openQuestions: IBKR callback provides permId/clientId inconsistently in current types; native lookup completeness remains empirical and controls capability.

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.ts:277-307: requestCurrentTime coalesces currentTimePromise, clears on timeout/send throw, and resolves currentTimePending from callback.
entries.currentBehavior: 并发 current-time 请求合并为一个 Promise；timeout 或同步 send throw 清空 cache，callback resolve。
entries.problem: mutable singleton/timer no generation or typed timestamp; timeout cannot distinguish probe read failure from connection recovery; caller may incorrectly mark alive.
preservedBehavior: 保留 coalescing, clear-on-failure, callback resolution。
将 success 仅作为 probe evidence，不再单独 markAlive。

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.ts:311-347: startAccountSubscription is idempotent, seeds pending cache and Promise, calls reqAccountUpdates; waitForAccountReady races a timeout; stop unsubscribes via client.
entries.currentBehavior: subscription 只启动一次，等待 first accountDownloadEnd；缓存和 readiness Promise 均为本地 mutable state；stop 使用 stored client unsubscribe。
entries.problem: 没有 AccountScope/accountName provenance、reconnect resubscribe/generation、durable checkpoint；timeout Promise 不清 pending state，client lifecycle outsider-owned。
preservedBehavior: 保留 idempotent start, full download end readiness, immediate deltas, stop unsubscribe。
replace local cache with typed stream and durable projection; no Alive from socket only.
openQuestions: Whether reqAccountUpdates callback accountName exactly matches managedAccounts token is empirical; mismatch must quarantine.

sourceEvidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ibkr/request-bridge.ts:351-395: resolve/reject helpers clear pending/collector/snapshot maps and timers; collector resolution accepts unknown values; order helpers key native orderId.
entries.currentBehavior: helper 按 reqId/orderId 查找 generic waiter，清 timer/delete maps，然后 resolve unknown callback item；collector array 类型由调用顺序推断。
